headline: North American Industry Groups Seek Tariff Relief Following US Midterm Shift
summary: Industry representatives, including the Chemistry Industry Association of Canada, noted that shifting political majorities in Washington have not alleviated cross-border tariff pressures on businesses.
why: Cross-border US-Canada supply chains and chemical processing depend closely on trade tariff levels under the USMCA trade framework.

impacts.name: North American Chemical Industry
impacts.why: Businesses face ongoing uncertainty regarding trade tariffs despite changes in US congressional leadership.
